acceptance_criteria.source: Issue MM-472 in turn 0: "Collect the set of DIDs whose reconcile errored this pass and exclude them from the sweep. Fail closed: an account whose references we could not compute must never have its blobs collected."
acceptance_criteria.text: After a blob GC pass, no blob (ownership row, physical `blobs` row, or file) belonging to an account whose reconcile errored in that same pass has been deleted by that pass's sweep; the sweep fails closed for such accounts.

acceptance_criteria.source: Issue MM-472 in turn 0: "Regression test: Reconcile fails for account A (repo walk error), A has an expired-grace unreferenced blob, a healthy account B has one too. Assert A's blob survives the pass and B's is collected."
acceptance_criteria.text: A regression test exists in which account A's reconcile fails (repo walk error) and A has an expired-grace unreferenced blob, healthy account B also has one; after the GC pass the test asserts A's blob survives and B's is collected.

acceptance_criteria.source: Issue MM-472 in turn 0: "a pass with `errors > 0` should not present as a clean \"pass complete\" — consider recording it distinctly in `sweep_status` / metrics so an operator has something to alert on."
acceptance_criteria.text: A blob GC pass with errors > 0 is distinguishable from a clean pass in what it reports (it is not presented as a plain clean "pass complete"), giving an operator a signal to alert on via log level, metrics, and/or sweep status.

acceptance_criteria.source: Fixing a bug in the pds crate implies the crate's existing checks still pass; the repository's own gate for this crate is `just ci-pds`, which the assistant identified as fmt, clippy, test, audit, ticket-ref and changelog.
acceptance_criteria.text: The repository's checks pass: the pds CI gate (`just ci-pds`: rustfmt, clippy with `-D warnings`, `cargo test -p pds`, audit, ticket-ref, changelog).

acceptance_criteria.source: The repository's CI gate includes changelog and ticket-ref checks, so a user-facing fix for MM-472 without a changelog.d entry referencing the ticket fails the repository's own checks.
acceptance_criteria.text: A changelog.d entry referencing MM-472 describes the fix.

The failing PDS CI gate on the PR is investigated using the hosted CI logs when reachable and the cause fixed so the gate passes; if CI cannot be reached, this is stated and the equivalent local gates (fmt, clippy, test) are run and pass.

The changes requested by the CodeRabbit review on the PR are read when the PR is reachable and each is either addressed in the code or explicitly declined with a reason; if the review cannot be reached, this is stated.

acceptance_criteria.source: Turn 3: "blob_gc_errors isn't exercised in the rendered-names pinning test (metrics.rs rendered_names_match_prometheus_conventions)... One .add(1, &[]) + one contains(\"blob_gc_errors_total\") assertion."
acceptance_criteria.text: The metrics.rs `rendered_names_match_prometheus_conventions` test exercises the blob GC errors counter with an `.add(1, &[])` and asserts the rendered output contains `blob_gc_errors_total`.

acceptance_criteria.source: Turn 3: "Doc wording overstates what errors counts. AGENTS.md says ... Either tighten the wording (\"reconcile failures plus individual sweep errors\") or add skipped blob counts into the tally — I'd tighten the wording"
acceptance_criteria.text: The description of the `errors` count in crates/pds/AGENTS.md and in the `/v1/admin/health` sweep-field doc matches what the code counts: either the wording is tightened (reconcile failures plus individual sweep errors, one per failed account rather than per skipped blob) or the tally is changed to include skipped blob counts.

acceptance_criteria.source: Turn 3: "stats.errors mixes two failure kinds — reconcile failures and sweep_expired_owner failures — in one counter... worth one clause in the names::BLOB_GC_ERRORS doc so nobody later assumes it's purely the skip count."
acceptance_criteria.text: The doc comment on `names::BLOB_GC_ERRORS` in metrics.rs states that the counter mixes reconcile failures and `sweep_expired_owner` failures, so it is not purely a skip count.

analysis.task_statement: Fix Linear issue MM-472 in the ezpds PDS crate: `run_blob_gc`'s global sweep deleted the blobs of any account whose reconcile errored in the same pass (silent, irreversible data loss). The fix must fail closed by excluding unreconciled accounts' expired ownership rows from the sweep, add the regression test described in the issue (failing account A keeps its expired blob, healthy account B's is collected), and make a pass with errors>0 observable rather than logged as a clean 'pass complete'. Follow-up turns handle CI failure, CodeRabbit review feedback, and three minor review findings about the new `errors` counter's test coverage and documentation.

turn_script.trigger: The replay has pushed a branch/PR and CI (PDS gate: fmt, clippy, test, audit) has run against it and failed.

turn_script.intent: Address three minor review findings: (1) exercise the blob_gc_errors counter in the metrics.rs rendered_names_match_prometheus_conventions test with one .add(1, &[]) and a contains("blob_gc_errors_total") assertion; (2) tighten doc wording in AGENTS.md and the health-field doc so `errors` is described as reconcile failures plus individual sweep errors (one per failed account, not per blob) rather than 'items/blobs the pass skipped'; (3) add a clause to the names::BLOB_GC_ERRORS doc noting it mixes reconcile failures and sweep_expired_owner failures.
